text:
Predicates:
Sitcom(x) ::: x is a British Sitcom series.
Star(x, y) ::: x stars in y.
Member(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Pilot(x, y) ::: x is piloted in y.
WorkingTitle(x, y) ::: x has working title y.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x is the script editor for y.
Premises:
Sitcom(badults) ∧ Star(membersOfPappys, badults) ::: Badults is a British Sitcom series starring members of Pappy's.
Pilot(badults, july2013) ∧ Pilot(badults, bbcThree) ::: Badults was piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three.
WorkingTitle(badults, theSecretDudeSociety) ::: The working title 'The Secret Dude Society' was used for Badults.
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.
Conclusion:
¬∃x ∃y (Member(x, pappys) ∧ Star(x, y) ∧ (Pilot(y, bbcTwo) ∨ Pilot(y, bbcThree))) ::: No members of Pappy's have starred in a show piloting on BBC Two or BBC Three.
